item.title: Kansas bill would require kindergarteners to be potty trained before starting school
item.description: BY GRACE HILLSKansas Reflector TOPEKA — Kansas lawmakers are considering a bill that would require kindergarteners to be potty trained before starting school, pulling the decision-making power about how to handle those students away from school districts. The House bill was introduced to reduce distractions in classrooms, supporters say. Opponents worry it would create a […]

item.title: National Weather Service Announces 2026 Storm Spotter Training Schedule
item.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) in Dodge City has released its 2026 spring storm spotter training schedule, offering residents across southwest Kansas multiple opportunities to learn how to identify severe weather and stay safe during storm season.

item.title: Kansas Releases New Grasslands Conservation Report
item.description: The Kansas Department of Agriculture (KDA), in partnership with the Kansas Association of Conservation Districts, has released a new foundational report highlighting the importance of preserving the state’s grasslands and outlining steps to strengthen conservation efforts for the future.

item.title: Renewable Fuels Association Pushes for Year-Round E15 Sales Amid Legislative Setback
item.description: The Renewable Fuels Association (RFA) is pushing to make E15, a gasoline blend containing 15% ethanol, available year-round, a move the industry says would benefit both consumers and retailers.
